title: Microsoft Purview DSPM: item-level investigation and remediation of overshared SharePoint items in data risk assessments (GCC, GCC High, DoD)
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, app prerequisites, assessment limits and administrator controls are supported. The Graph permission-granting call exists despite the automatic warning; its note should identify the request-body fields, and the remediation checklist names actions without a corresponding controls row.

claims.where: controls[0].api; Governance controls table
claims.claim: POST /v1.0/servicePrincipals/{id}/appRoleAssignedTo grants an application permission to a client service principal.
claims.quote: POST /servicePrincipals/{id}/appRoleAssignedTo; App roles that are assigned to service principals are also known as application permissions. Application permissions can be granted directly with app role assignments.
claims.fix: Keep the call. Append to controls[0].note: 'The request body sets appRoleId to the permission's app-role ID, principalId to the DSPM client service principal's object ID and resourceId to Microsoft Graph's service principal object ID; {id} is that resource service principal's object ID.'
